mapper.select: SELECT c.club_number as clubNumber, c.status, c.club_name as clubName, c.meeting_date as meetingDate, c.created_at as createdAt, f.festival_number as festivalNumber, f.festival_name as festivalName, c.CONTENTS, c.purpose, COUNT(atd.ATTENDEE_ID) as curCount, c.MAX_COUNT as maxCount FROM clubs c JOIN festivals f ON f.FESTIVAL_NUMBER = c.FESTIVAL_NUMBER JOIN attendees atd ON atd.CLUB_NUMBER = c.CLUB_NUMBER WHERE c.CLUB_NUMBER = #{clubNumber};

SELECT a.account_number as accountNumber, a.NICKNAME, atd.ATTENDEE_ROLE as attendeeRole FROM accounts a JOIN attendees atd ON atd.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = a.ACCOUNT_NUMBER JOIN clubs c ON c.CLUB_NUMBER = atd.CLUB_NUMBER WHERE c.CLUB_NUMBER = #{clubNumber};
mapper.update: UPDATE clubs SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE club_number = #{clubNumber};
